title: Witch Crafting
description: This mod adds new potion, dimension, functions, trees, wood etc...
body:
This mod adds a new dimension where the player gets trapped if he gets the new witch craft effect until he finds new structure with a loot where is lost igniter and they just click with it on the new witchcraft block that has a crafting recipe its in the image library of this mod. in the dimension is new biome where can be find villages, the new structure, animals, and instead of stone and dirt etc... is a witchcraft block. You can get into the dimension also with new command **/witchcrafthim "player name"**.
  There is a new witchy wood type with trapdoor, button, pressure plate, etc... The witchy tree can spawn in the new dimension. the block can also work as a projectile into the witchy shoot item that can be crafted by very rare crafting recipe that is in the image library of this mod. There is a potion for the new effect.
